text:
lina_sales: AuroraPay wants a short POC next week. Must show streaming (WS), function/tool-calling for payment extraction, strict JSON schema enforcement, SAML SSO, and customer KMS. They also asked for a procurement-friendly monthly estimate for reserved vs hosted. Can eng confirm what runnable samples we can finish in 48h?

omar_eng: We can put together Node + Python streaming samples and a small load-replay to approximate 1k QPS. Will keep the WS sample minimal. Example for demo: `ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'parse_tx', stream:true}))`.

jen_se: For structured output we'll use function calls + JSON Schema and show a validator that returns a 422-style structured error if mismatch. Example function result we expect: `{"tool":"extract_tx","args":{"from":"string","to":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}`.

omar_eng: Ops notes: batching window ~15-25ms recommended; dedicated pool for steady 1k QPS. Fallback policy: degrade to lower-capacity model with clear response header `x-redwood-fallback: true`. Ephemeral API tokens preferred for API access (TTL 15m).

mark_ops: I'll provision a reserved sandbox for the demo and hook up KMS (they use AWS CMK). Need the sample replay by EOD to run perf tests.

sara_legal: Send the security questionnaire to me. We require SOC2, KMS control docs, and data residency confirmation. Upload link: https://onetrust.example.com/aurorapay-upload.

lina_sales: Procurement wants a short monthly ballpark. Omar any quick numbers?

omar_eng: Very rough: reserved (4x A100 equiv) for steady 1k QPS ~ "$30k/mo". Hosted with autoscale + batching ~ "$18k/mo". I'll backfill with token assumptions tomorrow.

jen_se: Demo tip: show automatic schema rejection -> UI maps field errors to a helpful message. Also demo tool-call fallback where system returns `{"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"amount"}]}` so integrator can prompt user.

mark_ops: deploy_bot: created sandbox cluster: sandbox-aurorapay-01. Endpoints: `https://sandbox.redwood.ai/aurorapay`

lina_sales: Timeline: collect Aurora sample prompts today, sample runner + perf tomorrow morning, demo 4pm PT. I'll send invite.

omar_eng: I'll push Node + Python samples + replay script to the demo repo and paste links.

jen_se: I'll prepare the schema and a tiny validator UI snippet for the demo.

sara_legal: I'll send NDA + security packet after we get their contact.

lina_sales: Perfect, thanks everyone. Ping me on blockers. :thumbsup:
